text:
emily: Hey team, piling up — several customers are reporting 429s this morning but the rate-limit dashboard for their tenant shows zero throttles. Filing here so we can triage.

jamal: Which tenant IDs and timestamps? any repro request IDs?

emily: Tenant: t-4892, examples attached by customer: request ids r=abc123 / r=abc127 around 2024-06-22T09:14:xxZ. Customer says they saw 429 with body 'quota exceeded'. They want credits.

kevin: I'll pull enforcement logs now. Quick Q: are we sure the console query is using the right label? we recently changed the enforcement exporter label names in the last deploy.

maria: Customer repro steps: repeated post to /v1/completions with key sk-cust-*** until they got 429. They captured response headers: `X-RateLimit-Limit: 300`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0`, `Retry-After: 60`. They did not see corresponding line in our dashboard.

analytics-bot: metrics query snapshot (now): `sum(rate(rate_limit_enforcement_total{result="throttled",tenant_id="t-4892"}[5m]))` -> 0.

jamal: Ok pulling enforcement svc logs for t-4892 around those times... here's a short extract:

```
2024-06-22T09:14:02Z enforcement[pid=2345] INFO allow tenant=t-4892 req_id=abc120
2024-06-22T09:14:07Z enforcement[pid=2345] INFO throttle tenant=t-4892 req_id=abc123 reason=rate_limit_exceeded
2024-06-22T09:14:08Z enforcement[pid=2345] INFO throttle tenant=t-4892 req_id=abc127 reason=rate_limit_exceeded
```

jamal: Logs show throttles happened. So enforcement is returning 429s. That means either the exporter isn't sending the `throttled` metric or the dashboard query is missing it.

kevin: I remember a deploy yesterday where we renamed `tenant` -> `tenant_id` in the metrics exporter. Dashboard team merged a change to the console that expects `customer_id`. If enforcement is emitting `tenant_id` but console query uses `customer_id` we would see zeros.

maria: Is there a quick way to confirm what labels are in Prometheus?

kevin: Running a prometheus label_keys check now... `label_values(rate_limit_enforcement_total, tenant_id)` returns `t-4892`. `label_values(rate_limit_enforcement_total, customer_id)` returns empty. So dashboard queries using `customer_id` will miss everything.

analytics-bot: Alert: recent deploy 2024-06-21 22:11 UTC to enforcement-exporter changed label mapping (PR #4123).

product-lead: Oof — that PR should have been backwards compatible. What's the rollback/hotfix plan? Customers are asking for credits.

jamal: Quick mitigation options: 1) revert the exporter change (fast, requires deploy), 2) update dashboard queries to OR-match both labels (tenant_id or customer_id), 3) create a short-lived recording rule that copies `tenant_id` -> `customer_id` to be consumed by console. Option 3 is lowest risk and fastest.

kevin: I'll open a recording rule. Example rule: `rate_limit_enforcement_total_customer{customer_id="{{ tenant_id }}"} = rate_limit_enforcement_total{tenant_id="$1"}` — will iterate with ops. Deploying to prometheus now.

maria: For support: advise affected customers we're investigating and will credit for confirmed throttles. We need a list of tenant ids and timestamps to run backfill check.

emily: Sent customer a note: "We're investigating a metrics mismatch — enforcement did throttle you; our dashboard missed reporting due to a labels mismatch after a deploy. We're preparing credits and will follow up." :white_check_mark:

billing: Hold on credits until we have a validated count. Once we can query `throttled` counts for t-4892 for that window we'll calculate credits and action.

jamal: Prometheus rule deployed as a temporary mapping. Query now returns: `sum(rate(rate_limit_enforcement_total{result="throttled", customer_id="t-4892"}[5m]))` -> >0 for the suspected times.

kevin: Filing rollback PR to make exporter emit both labels for 7 days, then console will be updated to accept either label. PR: https://git.internal/r/4123-compat-link

product-lead: Please add a postmortem note: label-change without console coordination caused customer-visible gap. We'll need an owner for console-exporter compatibility tests.

emily: Customer confirmed receipt. They asked for ETA on credits; will update once billing signs off.

billing: Once we have the exact count (throttled token/time window) we'll apply credits. Expect ~24h for processing.

kevin: Follow-ups: 1) revert exporter to emit legacy `customer_id` label in addition to `tenant_id` (hotfix PR open), 2) update console queries to use `coalesce(customer_id, tenant_id)` style OR, 3) add integration test that simulates label rename.

jamal: I'll draft the short incident note for incidents/ with timeline and mitigation steps.

emily: Thanks everyone. Leaving thread open until credits applied and console is fixed. :pray:
